basic_details.job_title: BSAE Moradabad Academic Resource Person Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 10 Posts
basic_details.short_information: There are 10 Academic Resource Person (ARP) posts (अकादमिक रिसोर्स पर्सन) for the development blocks and the Nagar (city) resource centre of Moradabad district. Only teachers working in council schools under the Basic Shiksha Parishad, U.P. can apply. The Office of the District Basic Education Officer, Moradabad (कार्यालय जिला बेसिक शिक्षा अधिकारी मुरादाबाद) accepts applications only by registered post or speed post, sent to its office on Court Road, Moradabad. Applications must reach the office by 05 November 2026, 5:00 PM. Selection is through a written test and an interview.

content_sections.heading: About BSA Moradabad
content_sections.text: The Office of the District Basic Education Officer, Moradabad is the district-level office for basic education in Moradabad, Uttar Pradesh. The ARP posts are being filled under Samagra Shiksha, as part of reorganising the Block Resource Centres. The notice follows a letter from the Director General, School Education and State Project Director, Samagra Shiksha, U.P., Lucknow (letter no. गुण०वि०/ए०आर०पी०/2058/2026-27, dated 24 June 2026) and Government Order no. I/1358920/2026, 68-5099/375/2025-अनुभाग-5 (बेसिक शिक्षा), dated 15 June 2026. The District Selection Committee approved the selection, and the notice is signed by Amit Singh, District Basic Education Officer, Moradabad.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: You must use the prescribed application format. The notice says the format is attached to it, and that the ARP application form is available at the district headquarters and at the BRC (Block Resource Centre). Send the application to this address: District Basic Education Officer Office (जिला बेसिक शिक्षा अधिकारी कार्यालय), Court Road, Moradabad, PIN Code-244001 Get the ARP application form in the prescribed format from the district headquarters or the BRC. Fill in the form and attach all the enclosures. Have the application, with all its enclosures, forwarded by your Block Education Officer (खण्ड शिक्षा अधिकारी). This is compulsory. Put the application in a sealed envelope. Write the name of the development block you are applying for clearly, in bold letters, on top of the envelope. Send it only by registered post or speed post (पंजीकृत डाक / रजिस्टर्ड डाक / स्पीड पोस्ट डाक). It must reach the office by 05 November 2026, 5:00 PM. An application will be rejected without any further correspondence if it is not in the prescribed format, if it reaches the District Basic Education Officer's office after the last date, or if it was not sent by registered or speed post. The applicant is responsible for any such rejection. Applications are invited block by block, in line with the number of vacancies in each block. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: There are 10 Academic Resource Person (ARP) posts in total. They are split across the development blocks as shown below. The number of posts may be reduced or increased as needed. Qualification: a graduation degree (स्नातक उपाधि) with a teacher training qualification. Experience: at least 5 years of teaching experience in council primary or upper primary schools. Service left: at least 5 years must remain before your retirement. No inquiry of any kind may be pending against you, and you must never have been found guilty in any disciplinary proceedings. Former ARPs who have already completed the maximum 3-year ARP tenure cannot be selected. There is one exception: if a block resource centre receives fewer applications than it has posts, ARPs who have completed 3 years may apply. Cut-off date: teaching experience and the minimum service left before retirement are counted from 05 November 2026. Item 13 of the notice also says that teaching experience and age are calculated from the date of the office memo. For the full eligibility conditions of the post, see the official notification and the Government Order dated 15 June 2026. Tenure: each ARP term is 1 year. It is renewed every year after a Performance Appraisal and approval by the District Selection Committee. An ARP can serve for a maximum of 3 years. Salary: the ARP keeps being paid from their own school (कार्यरत मूल विद्यालय). There is no increase in salary. Mobility allowance: ARPs do supportive supervision (सहयोगात्मक पर्यवेक्षण) against a monthly target. If they meet the target, they are paid a mobility allowance of Rs. 4,500/- per month as per the rules, after submitting a mobility bill (मोबिलिटी देयक पत्रक). No incentive of any kind is paid apart from the travel allowance.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection has two stages: a written test, then an interview. The final merit list is based on the marks from both. The merit list will be prepared from the combined marks of the written test and the interview. The selection criteria and other guidelines follow the Government Order dated 15 June 2026.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in BSA Moradabad ARP Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 10 Academic Resource Person (ARP) posts: 3 in Moradabad Nagar, 2 each in Bilari and Mundha Pande, and 1 each in Bhagatpur Tanda, Chhajlet and Kundarki. The number of posts may be reduced or increased as needed.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for Moradabad ARP?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the District Basic Education Officer Office, Court Road, Moradabad by 05 November 2026, 5:00 PM. Applications that arrive late will be rejected.

faq.question: Q3. Who can apply for the ARP posts?
faq.answer: Only teachers working in council schools under the Basic Shiksha Parishad, U.P. can apply. They need a graduation degree with a teacher training qualification, at least 5 years of teaching experience in council primary or upper primary schools, and at least 5 years of service left before retirement.

faq.question: Q4. How do I apply for BSA Moradabad ARP?
faq.answer: Fill in the prescribed form, which you can get from the district headquarters or the BRC, and have it forwarded by your Block Education Officer with all enclosures. Then send it in a sealed envelope by registered post or speed post to District Basic Education Officer Office, Court Road, Moradabad, PIN Code-244001.

faq.question: Q5. What should I write on the envelope?
faq.answer: Write the name of the development block you are applying for clearly, in bold letters, on top of the envelope.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for ARP in Moradabad?
faq.answer: There is a 70-mark written test followed by a 30-mark interview. Only candidates who score 60 percent or more in the written test are called for the interview, and the merit list is based on the marks from both.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary of an ARP?
faq.answer: The ARP keeps drawing their salary from their own school, with no increase. A mobility allowance of Rs. 4,500/- per month is paid as per the rules if the monthly supervision target is met and a mobility bill is submitted.

faq.question: Q8. What is the tenure of an Academic Resource Person?
faq.answer: Each term is 1 year. It is renewed every year after a Performance Appraisal and approval by the District Selection Committee, up to a maximum of 3 years.

faq.question: Q9. Can a former ARP who has completed 3 years apply again?
faq.answer: No. Former ARPs who have completed the maximum 3-year tenure cannot be selected, unless a block resource centre receives fewer applications than it has posts. In that case, they may apply.
